_notes: Contract 1 v1.4.0 -- adds page_width/page_height/rotation_degrees/detected_language and a richer quality_check (score + issues[]) per external review. Also explicitly documents WHY is_duplicate/duplicate_of_document_id are deliberately NOT included here (see duplicate_detection_boundary_note) -- a prior review suggested adding them, but that would violate the Reader/Duplicate-Detector separation already established in contract_duplicate_detection.json.
duplicate_detection_boundary_note: This contract deliberately does NOT include is_duplicate or duplicate_of_document_id fields. Reasoning: (1) EXACT duplicates are caught by the Binary Duplicate Detector BEFORE the Reader ever runs -- the Reader produces no output at all for those, by design, to save extraction cost. (2) POSSIBLE duplicates (same report, different file) can only be detected AFTER extraction, and that is explicitly the Semantic Duplicate Detector's job (a separate component, see contract_duplicate_detection.json), kept apart from the Reader for Single Responsibility. Adding duplicate fields here would smuggle that responsibility back into the Reader.

shape.mime_type: string, e.g. 'application/pdf' -- actual detected MIME type
shape.report_date_confidence: 'HIGH' | 'LOW' | null -- HIGH if unambiguous date format found, LOW if a date was found but format was ambiguous (day-first vs month-first) and was NOT guessed, null if no date pattern found at all

pages.extractor_used: 'pdfplumber' | 'tesseract' | 'vision_llm_fallback' | 'pandas' -- PER PAGE, since a single PDF can mix digital and scanned pages
pages.tables: list of tables; each a list of rows; each row a list of cell strings
pages.average_page_confidence: float 0-1 or null -- OCR confidence averaged over RECOGNIZED WORDS ONLY on this page; null if not an OCR page
pages.page_width: float or null -- enables future bounding-box/highlight features; null for csv/xlsx
pages.detected_language: string or null, e.g. 'en' -- best-effort only, populate if trivially available, not used for routing in this build

extraction_log.operation_id: string -- unique per read_document() call, consistent across all log entries for one document

quality_check.issues: array of strings from fixed vocabulary: 'LOW_RESOLUTION' | 'LOW_TEXT_DENSITY' | 'OCR_FAILURE' | 'PARTIAL_PAGE' | 'REPEATED_CHARACTERS' | 'NEAR_EMPTY', empty if passed cleanly
